english:
[Prayer] verse 2. "against evil."
Prophet Nahum 1:7. "The Lord is good," to verse 9. "in affliction."
Prophet Habakkuk 1:1. "How long, O Lord," to verse 3. "wickedness."
Prophet Zephaniah 1:7. "Be silent before the face," to verse 8. "strange apparel."
Prophet Haggai 2:7[8]. "Thus says the Lord," to verse 10[11]. "this temple."
Prophet Zechariah 7:9. "Thus says the Lord Almighty," to verse 13. "says the Lord Almighty."
Prophet Malachi 1:4. "Thus says the Lord Almighty," to verse 6. "the Lord Almighty."
The Apostle, Romans 11:2. "Do you not know of Elijah," to verse 5. "according to grace."
Alleluia. "In the churches."
Gospel, Luke 13:31. "In that same," to verse 35. "of the Lord."

Wednesday, Tone 2 [bka]. Fathers Tone 1 [ak]: "Ineffable essence."
Midday Psalm 85 [86]: "Save your servant."
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 7:25. "Now concerning virgins," to verse 35. "without distraction."
Alleluia: "Turn, O Lord."
Gospel, Matthew 19:13. "Then they brought," to verse 26. "all things are possible."

Thursday, Tone 3 [ga]. Of the Saints: Sophia, and her three daughters: Pistis, Elpis, and Agape.
Fathers Tone 8 [dza]: "Who trust."
Midday Psalm 44 [45]: "Hear, O daughter."
Proverbs 11:30. "From the fruit of righteousness," to 12:4. "to her husband."
Prophet Hosea 14:6[7]. "Thus says the Lord," to verse 9[10]. "it shall be for Ephraim."
The Apostle, 2 Corinthians 4:6. "For God," to verse 14. "with you."
Alleluia: "The queen shall stand."
Gospel, Luke 12:2. "For there is nothing," to verse 10. "it shall not be forgiven him."

Friday, Tone 3 [gka]. Fathers of Rest.
Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "They have seen."
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 11:1. "Be imitators of me," to verse 16. "the churches of God."
Alleluia: "Have mercy on me, O Lord."
Gospel, Mark 1:35. "And in the morning," to verse 45. "from all sides."

If, according to the calendar, a fourth Sunday is required here, see the second Sunday after the Octave. If a fifth is also required, see the third Sunday after the Octave. But if a sixth is also required, then place the first Sunday after the Octave here in place of the fourth; place the second Sunday here in place of the fifth; and place the third Sunday here in place of the sixth. But for the Fathers [hymns], consult the calendar.

On the Saturday of the Eve [of the Fast] it is always the Feast of the Holy Council of Ephesus of the Two Hundred Patriarchs.
[At Morning Service] Tone 3 [ga]: "Today the holy patriarchs," with its canons.
Magnificat [Mankunk] Tone 3 [ga]: "O wonderful."
At Midday, Introit: "The patriarchal."
Hymn Tone 8 [dza]: "Today the heavenly."
Psalm 131 [132]: "Your priests."
Prophet Ezekiel 3:16. "And the word," to verse 19. "you shall save."
The Apostle, 2 Timothy 1:6. "For which cause I remind you," to verse 14. "dwelling in us."
Alleluia: "Your priests."
Gospel, Luke 10:16. "He who hears you," to verse 20. "are in heaven."
In the Evening: "Gladsome Light" [Luys Zuvart].
Messedi: "I loved."
Hambartsi [Hymn at Evening]: "Holy art Thou, Lord."
"Save us" [Ketso], and the rest.

On Sunday, which is the Eve of the Fast of the Holy Mother of God.
Fathers of the Resurrection.
Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "To You is praise due."
Prophet Isaiah 7:1. "And it came to pass in the days," to verse 9. "the son of Remaliah."
Psalm: "Holy is Your temple."
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 13:11. "When I was a child," to 14:5. "may receive edification."
Alleluia: "You have been pleased."
Gospel, Mark 2:1. "And when He entered again," to verse 12. "We never saw."
In the Evening, Hambartsi [Hymn]: Of the Resurrection.
And then the Fast of the Assumption of the Holy Mother of God, during which there are no feasts.

Monday of the Fast. Fathers of Repentance, according to the order.
Midday Introit: "Who wast sent from the Father."
Hymn Tone 3 [ga]: "O Christ God, remember."
Psalm 144 [145]: "Your kingdom."
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 14:18. "I thank God," to verse 25. "God is in you."
Alleluia: "Come, let us rejoice."
Gospel, Mark 2:13. "And He went out again," to verse 20. "in those days."

Tuesday. Fathers of Repentance.
Midday Psalm 5: "I will worship."
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 14:26. "How is it then," to verse 40. "be done decently."
Alleluia: "Sing to the Lord."
Gospel, Mark 2:23. "And it came to pass that He," to 3:5. "his hand."
